newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Palm - currency distortions fully corrected.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Palm - currency distortions fully corrected.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Guntram Palm said on Tuesday currency distortions had now fully corrected and the Bundesbank was not overly concerned by small movements of a few pfennigs against the dollar.
"The strong currency market distortions that we experienced in 1995 have now fully corrected," Palm told Reuters in an interview.

Asked whether the Bundesbank was concerned that the dollar had risen to as high as 1.71 marks on Tuesday, Palm repeated Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer's statements that the correction was "appropriate".
"I refer back to the statement made by Tietmeyer that this is an appropriate correction and a movement of a few pfennigs do not invalidate this statement," Palm said.
Palm is also the president of the state central bank of Baden-Wuerttemberg.
